summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running anything, and nothing is committed. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar now yields one Text with clickable_ranges as fourth input and width fifth; Opacity keeps non-color style attributes; LayoutEdge dataclass added to _layout_resolve.py; docs/reference/tabs.md; new underline-bar tests appended to tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py; new tests/widgets/test_tabs.py and __init__.py. Choices to review: click action is range_clicked('Name') because the literal spec form would not parse through actions.parse; bar position uses the displayed index of the active name so duplicates place the underline under the displayed tab; letter search only accepts single-character keys; a zero-width label edge becomes flexible due to the resolver's size-or-None behavior; sandbox demo skipped as optional. Tests were not run; library behavior was checked by reading rich 11.2.0's vendored copy.
